description: The one universal Voyager. Give a goal in plain language; Voyager activates the senses it needs and runs a live mission, returning a graph of CognitiveClaims (observe/infer), the entities/relationships/contradictions found across senses, and the single most informative next probe. Provide `repoPath` to orient in a local repository (voyager-repo) and/or `host`+`authorized:true` to audit ONE host you own (voyager-net, FAIL-CLOSED). Sensing is read-only and autonomous; any remediation stays consent-gated and is NEVER applied here. isError:true means the mission could not run, not that the systems are clean.

authorized.description: Assert you own/are permitted to test `host`. Required to audit it.

checkDeps.description: Verify up to N dependencies during the repo scout.

host.description: A single host/domain you own, to audit.

repoPath.description: A local repository path to orient in.

url.description: A live http(s) URL to observe (read-only page sense).

name: run_mission
